noHousehold.title: Welcome
noHousehold.intro: Create a household, or join one with the code someone in it has.
noHousehold.name: Household name

week.title: Week {{number}}
week.noChores: No chores yet. Add them under Household.
week.legend: Tap + to plan yourself in, or to mark who did the chore today or earlier. Tap a letter once it's done.
week.legendDay: Plan takes the chore on that day, Done ticks it off. The arrow marks it as done by you or someone else.

history.title: History
history.since: Since {{date}}. The number after the slash is the target for the whole period.

household.inviteHelp: Give this code to whoever is joining:
household.choresHelp: The target is how many times each member should do the chore per week. Leave it empty for chores done when needed.
household.confirmDelete: Delete {{name}}? Its entries from earlier weeks are deleted too.

account.emailNeedsPassword: Needed to change your email, since it's your login.
account.colorHelp: Your entries and dots show in this colour for everyone in the household. Colours someone else has can't be picked.

landing.title: Chores, without the sheet on the fridge.
landing.lead: Plan the week, tick off what you've done and see who does what. For the whole household, on your phone.
landing.weekdays: Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri Sat Sun
landing.dayText: Take a chore on the day that suits you. Everyone sees who took what, and nobody decides for anyone else.
landing.quotaText: Chores to be done a set number of times a week show as dots that fill as you do them.
landing.forgotTitle: Tick it off for whoever forgot
landing.forgotText: Anyone can mark a chore as done for someone else, and it shows who made the mark.
landing.summaryText: See how the chores were shared this week or over the last few months. No tally marks to add up.
landing.coloursText: Everyone in the household gets their own colour, mixed from the same three print inks as the rest of the app. Pink and blue make purple, blue and yellow make green.
landing.inviteText: Whoever creates the household gets an eight-character code. Everyone else joins in a minute.
landing.closingTitle: The sheet on the fridge can retire.
